title: Innokin Jem Tank 2ml
description: The slim and durable JEM tank has a 2ml eliquid capacity and utilises a convenient top-fill system for easy refilling. The Innokin Jem tank has a tighter MTL (mouth-to-lung) draw that mimics traditional cigarettes, making it the ideal kit for newer vapers. The tank includes two 1.6ohm coils, one pre-installed, that provide exquisite flavour and reliable performance and work best with high-PG , 50/50 and nicotine salts eliquids. The Innokin JEM Vape Kit is a compact, stylish mod and tank combo from Innokin that features a large 1000mAh capacity, adjustable wattage control and adjustable airflow.
